subject: Television & Streaming
title: Ellen's Coming Out Episode
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ellen's Coming Out Episode.

hook.text: In 1997, Ellen DeGeneres came out as gay on her sitcom—the first lead character on American TV to do so.

buildup.text: The episode drew 42 million viewers. It was a cultural event covered by every major news outlet in the country.

discovery.text: ABC lost advertisers immediately. Chrysler and JCPenney pulled their commercials. The backlash was swift and financial.

twist.text: ABC canceled Ellen one year later. DeGeneres's career stalled for years. The cost of being first was enormous.

climax.text: But Ellen's coming out cracked open a door.

punchline.text: One sitcom episode cost a career and changed a culture.

quiz.question: What was the immediate consequence of Ellen's coming out episode?
options: Major advertisers pulled their commercials and the show was later canceled
